references.title: DWDS: hin
references.supports: Adverb with no Wortzerlegung; Etymologie: ahd. hina, an old n-suffix formation on a pronoun stem, not a German one

notes.rationale: durch die Stadt hin, the direction away from the speaker. DWDS gives no Wortzerlegung, so it is a bottom word. An adverb is indeclinable, so it has no Ending, not even ∅ (ADR 0051): the Root hin alone.
